execution_paths.flow: cargo build/test -> rustc + linker -> cuatro binarios y libs
CLI -> parser -> semantics/module -> IR -> bytecode -> stdout
CLI -> bytecode verify -> VM/provider -> trace/report/evidence; verify-evidence -> signature
suite JSON -> bibliotecas Rust in-process -> workdir/resultados
CLI -> OS randomness o seed explícito -> Ed25519 -> archivos de claves/firma
Next route -> execFileSync argorixc/argorix-vm -> plan -> fetch en TypeScript
Python subprocess -> collector -> release CLIs + eval-tripwire + signer -> score/render
Python fixtures/oráculo interno -> tablas (no sustituye evidencia independiente)
make -> PowerShell -> Python + cargo/VM para verificar -> Tectonic + Poppler -> PDF
